title: When the Bill Falls: Reusing the Old Index Defers,Never Avoids, Re-encoding in Complete Embedding-Model Migration
abstract: arXiv:2611.20702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Upgrading the embedding model behind a vector index requires re-encoding the corpus. Recent work reuses the old index through adapters or window re-ranking. Across sixteen model pairs on passage and code corpora, plus eleven on Natural Questions (NQ), we find three results. First, reuse never avoids re-encoding: if migration must complete, every strategy eventually encodes every document; reuse only changes when that work is paid and the quality served meanwhile. Second, adapters should be compared with the old model, not only the new one. Of five adapter variants, only same-family LLM bridges beat the old model, and only by a negligible margin. Third, window re-ranking cost can be priced from the old index alone; pre-registered replays on all 8,841,823 passages confirmed the prediction on all three tested pairs. Workload skew also matters: across 36 further pre-registered Zipf replays, the planned family matched on 32. These findings

translated_title: 当账单落下时：在完整的嵌入模型迁移中，复用旧索引只会推迟而无法避免重新编码
translated_abstract: 将向量索引背后的嵌入模型进行升级，需要对语料库进行重新编码。最近的研究通过适配器或窗口重排序来复用旧索引。在段落和代码语料库上的十六对模型，以及Natural Questions（NQ）数据集上的十一对模型的实验中，我们发现了三个结果。第一，复用永远无法避免重新编码：如果迁移必须完成，每种策略最终都会对每个文档进行编码；复用只是改变了这项工作何时被支付以及期间所提供的检索质量。第二，适配器应该与旧模型进行比较，而不仅仅是与新模型比较。在五种适配器变体中，只有同系列的LLM桥接方法优于旧模型，而且优势微乎其微。第三，窗口重排序的成本可以仅凭旧索引来估算；在全部8,841,823个段落上进行的预注册重放实验证实了这一预测，在所有三个测试的模型对上均得到验证。工作负载偏斜同样重要：在36次额外的预注册Zipf分布重放中，规划的成本模型在32次中与实际情况吻合。
tldr: 该论文通过大规模实验证明，复用旧索引只能推迟而非真正避免嵌入模型迁移中的重新编码工作，并提出了适配器应以旧模型为基准进行评估、窗口重排序成本可仅凭旧索引预先估算等实用结论。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates through large-scale experiments that reusing the old index merely defers, rather than avoids, re-encoding in complete embedding-model migration, and shows that adapters should be benchmarked against the old model while window re-ranking costs can be predicted from the old index alone.
